releaseNotes: v8.10.0: Web Novel Ingestion Controls (Pause, Cancel, Resume) with crash-proof persistence (chapter-by-chapter IndexedDB save, incomplete badges in Library, 1-tap continuation after app exit); Google Drive Cloud Sync & Auto-Backup engine modeled on Mihon/Komikku standard (OAuth 2.0, drive.appdata private storage, drive.file folder choice, test link, manual token override, and auto-sync on translation completion).
